title: Roasted Cabbage Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful roasted cabbage dish served in a bowl, great as a side or light meal.

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.notes: green or red cabbage works well

instructions: Cut the cabbage into wedges and place in a bowl.
Drizzle the olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder over the cabbage.
Toss the cabbage to coat evenly.
Spread the cabbage out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and drizzle with sesame oil (if using).
Serve hot in bowls, garnished with additional sesame oil (if desired).
Optional: top with your choice of protein (chicken, tofu, etc.) or other toppings.
